text: I always try to be polite and follow rules, but the only thing that has ever worked for me here (getting an urgent doctor's appointment with a specialist, getting a refund that I'm legally entitled to, getting fair treatment at the airport when I only had a visa and not a passport) is having my husband call or come with me and shout and make a fuss. For that first example, I had horrible back pain during my 2nd pregnancy. I knew if I didn't take care of it I would really feel it during labor. I had a referral to see a PT. Maccabi rep on the phone was giving me appointment dates AFTER I would have given birth. I was pregnant and in pain and scared and they wouldn't budge. My husband called and yelled in Hebrew and what do you know? Appointment two days later. (And the PT was great.) I'm with you - sometimes it's just better to have the person who can make a fuss in Hebrew go along.
